units.speaker: Anna
units.text: So what actually happened to Brussels in August of 1695?

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It was during the Nine Years' War.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: A French army under Marshal Villeroi marched on the city, and the aim was not to capture it.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: The French wanted to draw their enemies away from the siege of the fortress of Namur.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Brussels was rich and poorly defended, so it made a tempting target.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: That is a terrible reason to lose a city centre.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It is. About a third of the buildings in Brussels were destroyed or badly damaged, and the Grand Place was in ruins.
